tasks.title: Add Creator Studio Meta Tags and Favicon
tasks.description: Give /createur its own title, description, Open Graph tags, and real favicon (currently inherits generic Salon meta)
tasks.details:
Creator Studio serves generic Salon meta tags and no og:image. No real favicon (serves SPA fallback).

Implementation:
1. Create new favicon specifically for Creator Studio:
   - Design: stylized paint palette or artist studio icon in gold (#c5a059) on black
   - Generate favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon.png, favicon-32x32.png, favicon-16x16.png
   - Place in public/creator-studio/ directory
2. Update apps/salon/index.html OR use react-helmet/react-helmet-async to set meta dynamically on /createur route:
   - title: "Creator Studio · Le Salon des Inconnus" (FR) / "Creator Studio · House of the Rising Arts" (EN)
   - description FR: "Plateforme créative pour artistes : galerie, portfolios, résidences, communauté."
   - description EN: "Creative platform for artists: gallery, portfolios, residencies, community."
3. Add Open Graph tags:
   - og:title, og:description (bilingual)
   - og:image: create or use existing Creator Studio hero image (public/salon-creator-studio.png exists at apps/hub/public/)
   - og:url: https://inconnus-salon.web.app/createur (or final production URL)
   - twitter:card: summary_large_image
4. Inject meta tags conditionally when route is /createur using react-helmet-async

Pseudo-code (App.tsx or CreatorStudioShell.tsx):
```typescript
import { Helmet } from 'react-helmet-async';

<Helmet>
  <title>Creator Studio · Le Salon des Inconnus</title>
  <meta name="description" content={language === 'FR' 
    ? 'Plateforme créative pour artistes : galerie, portfolios, résidences, communauté.'
    : 'Creative platform for artists: gallery, portfolios, residencies, community.'} />
  <meta property="og:title" content="Creator Studio" />
  <meta property="og:image" content="https://inconnus-salon.web.app/salon-creator-studio.png" />
  <link rel="icon" href="/creator-studio/favicon.ico" />
</Helmet>
```
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Share /createur link on Slack/Twitter → correct title, description, and og:image preview
2. Browser tab shows Creator Studio favicon, not generic Salon icon
3. View page source → meta tags present and correct for both FR/EN
4. Lighthouse SEO audit passes with proper meta tags

tasks.title: Hide or Disable TTS Button When Gemini Key Absent
tasks.description: Conditionally hide article text-to-speech button when Gemini API key is not configured
tasks.details:
TTS button visible in article reader but fails silently when Gemini key absent from bundle (intentional for security).

Implementation:
1. Locate TTS button in ArtsPage.tsx or article reader component (grep found ArtsPage.tsx contains TTS references)
2. Add environment variable check:
   - Read import.meta.env.VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY
   - If undefined/empty, set hasTTS = false
3. Conditionally render TTS button only when hasTTS is true
4. Alternative: show disabled button with tooltip "Feature unavailable" if design requires placeholder
5. Ensure no console errors when key absent

Pseudo-code (ArtsPage.tsx or article component):
```typescript
const hasTTS = !!import.meta.env.VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY;

{hasTTS && (
  <button onClick={playTTS} className="...">
    {language === 'FR' ? 'Écouter' : 'Listen'}
  </button>
)}
```
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Build without VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY set → TTS button hidden
2. Build with key present → TTS button visible and functional
3. No console errors in either configuration
4. UI gracefully handles missing feature (no broken layout)

   - Update titleEn/titleFr to match actual photos
